# frostmoln_messaging_permission (Data Source)

Look up one application user's permission on one vhost of a managed messaging (LavinMQ) instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "frostmoln_messaging_permission" "billing_orders" {
  instance_id = "51455a51-db3d-4231-ac27-4fee2553c15f"
  user        = "billing-app"
  vhost       = "orders"
}

output "billing_orders_read" {
  value = data.frostmoln_messaging_permission.billing_orders.read
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The id of the messaging instance.
- `user` (String) The user's name.
- `vhost` (String) The vhost's name.

### Read-Only

- `configure` (String) The configure regex the broker was last given: at most 255 bytes, never starting with `-`; `^$` grants nothing.
- `created_at` (String) When the permission was created.
- `failure_message` (String) The last failed change's reason in words, or null.
- `failure_reason` (String) The stable code of the permission's last failed change, or null.
- `id` (String) The permission's id, `<instance_id>/<user>/<vhost>`.
- `read` (String) The read regex the broker was last given: at most 255 bytes, never starting with `-`; `^$` grants nothing.
- `status` (String) The permission's status: `pending`, `ready`, `deleting` or `error`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the permission last changed.
- `write` (String) The write regex the broker was last given: at most 255 bytes, never starting with `-`; `^$` grants nothing.
